codeReview.summary: The Job creator implementation is solid and well-tested. All 8 validation assertions (VAL-K8S-001 through VAL-K8S-008) are covered by comprehensive tests. The code follows project conventions and handles edge cases correctly. One minor observation about resource limits discrepancy between feature description and AGENTS.md, but the feature description takes precedence.

issues.description: Resource limits in implementation (500m CPU, 512Mi memory for both requests and limits) match the feature description exactly. However, AGENTS.md specifies 'Job CPU: 500m request, 1000m limit' and 'Job memory: 512Mi request, 1Gi limit'. This discrepancy exists between feature description (authoritative for this feature) and AGENTS.md. No action required as feature description is authoritative.
Minor test formatting change was made in a later commit (formatting fix for TestGetJobProgress). This is cosmetic and does not affect functionality.
